offers.rationale: C1 has the lowest total cost ($269.52) and least holding (2 min, 80 kg) of the candidates, and it passes W-1 and T-1. It fails R-1 only at SL-2024 because DL1187 occupies it, so offering ATC_EARLIER_SLOT to resequence DL1187 is what makes C1 workable.

C1 needs only 2 min extra holding (80 kg), which keeps F-1 passing at 2280 kg against the 1800 kg reserve, and it has the lowest total cost at $269.52 with 0 missed connections. The candidates that need my PILOT_EXTRA_HOLDING (C4 to C8) cost $5982.36 or more with 18 missed connections, so offering that concession is not justified.

C3 at gate B9 passes G-2 and C-1 (CRW-B9 on shift) and needs only ATC_EARLIER_SLOT, with total_usd 269.52 and no crew move. C2 costs the same 269.52 but needs my GROUND_REASSIGN_CREW, which is clearly better than C5 (5982.36) and C8 (7195.2), so I offer it for C2.

C2 passes every check, including F-1 at 2280 kg against the 1800 kg reserve after 2 min extra holding (80 kg). Its cost is $269.52 with 0 missed connections, and it needs no PILOT_EXTRA_HOLDING from me.

C2 passes all my checks (G-1, G-2, G-3, C-1) with no overtime and 0 missed connections at $269.52, the same cost as C3 and far below C5 and C8. The reassigned crew CRW-B9 covers gate B7, so the crew check holds.
